summary: community.network is unmaintained and deprecated as a whole; anyone wanting to maintain parts should copy them to their own repository and announce it on the forum.
questions: What should I do if I depend on a community.network module?

answer_card.title: community.network is unmaintained
answer_card.answer_md: The whole **community.network** collection is unmaintained and deprecated. If you rely on parts of it, copy them into your own repository (or a new collection) and announce it in the Forum discussion.
